title: leria exscapa
intro: Leria exscapa, commonly known as the "Desert Lavender", is a flowering plant native to the southwestern regions of North America. It is prized for its calming effects and numerous health benefits, including its ability to reduce anxiety and promote a restful sleep. The therapeutic actions of Leria exscapa include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help soothe skin irritations and wounds. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
